mechanism: Both drugs inhibit cardiac potassium channels and can prolong QT interval, with additive risk of torsades de pointes, particularly in patients with electrolyte abnormalities or baseline QT prolongation.
action: Monitor QTc interval and electrolytes (especially potassium and magnesium); consider alternative antimicrobial if possible, or use with caution if combination is necessary; ensure baseline ECG in high-risk patients.
